title: Built this 3D game with ChatGPT 6 Astra in one morning
author: Bananaboy1107
selftext:
Spent this morning messing around with ChatGPT 6 Astra and ended up building this little 3D web game.

Took about one morning from idea to something actually playable.

I didn't use any extra art assets. The characters, map, effects and UI were all made during the process with AI.

Pretty crazy how fast you can prototype a game now as a solo dev.

The main downside is the token usage ！！！ Astra burns through them pretty fast, so I had to wait for the 5-hour reset before continuing.

The video is the actual game running on my phone.

If anyone wants to try it, feel free to DM me. Happy to send you the URL

Would also love to hear any feedback. Thanks!
